'''''Acmispon''''' is a [[genus]] of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Fabaceae]] (legumes), native to North America and the west coast of [[Chile]] in South America.<ref name=powo/> It includes several species of [[United States|American]] '''bird's-foot trefoils''' and '''deervetches''' formerly contained in the globally distributed genus ''[[Lotus (genus)|Lotus]]''. The former genus ''Syrmatium'' is included in ''Acmispon''.<ref name=POWO_30041516-2/> The Jepson eFlora accepts only ''Acmispon''.<ref name=Jepson_Acmispon/>
